nodes.title: Hoffman basis of $\mathfrak{H}^1$

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{Q}\langle x, y\rangle$ be the free associative $\mathbb{Q}$-algebra on two letters $x$ and $y$, whose monomials are the words in $x$ and $y$. The subalgebra $\mathfrak{H}^1$ of $\mathbb{Q}\langle x, y\rangle$ is the $\mathbb{Q}$-linear span of the words that are empty or end in $y$; equivalently, it consists of the polynomials in which every word with nonzero coefficient is empty or ends in $y$.
nodes.title: The subalgebra $\mathfrak{H}^1$

nodes.summary: The type whose elements are the indices that are admissible, that is, nonempty with first entry at least $2$, or that have no entries.
nodes.title: The type of empty or admissible indices

nodes.summary: A word $w$ in the two letters $x$ and $y$ is an $\mathfrak{H}^1$-word when $w$ is empty or $w = uy$ for some word $u$, that is, when $w$ is empty or ends in $y$.
nodes.title: Words of $\mathfrak{H}^1$

nodes.summary: An index is empty-or-admissible when it is admissible, that is, nonempty with first entry at least $2$, or when it has no entries.
nodes.title: Empty or admissible indices

nodes.summary: A word $w$ in the two letters $x$ and $y$ is an $\mathfrak{H}^0$-word when $w$ is empty or $w = xuy$ for some word $u$, that is, when $w$ is empty or begins with $x$ and ends in $y$.
nodes.title: Words of $\mathfrak{H}^0$

nodes.summary: For an index $(k_1, \dots, k_r)$, this is the list $(k_1, \dots, k_r)$ of its entries in order, each regarded as a positive integer.
nodes.title: Entries of an index as positive integers

nodes.summary: This is the submonoid of the free monoid on the two letters $x$ and $y$ consisting of the words that are empty or end in $y$.

nodes.title: The monoid of $\mathfrak{H}^0$-words

nodes.summary: In the free monoid on the two letters $x$ and $y$, with $x$ represented by the Boolean value false and $y$ by true, this is the word of length one consisting of the letter $x$.
nodes.title: The letter $x$ as a word

nodes.summary: In the free monoid on the two letters $x$ and $y$, this is the word of length one consisting of the single letter $y$.
nodes.title: The letter $y$ as a word

nodes.summary: For an index $\mathbf{k} = (k_1, \dots, k_r)$ of positive integers, this is the monomial $z_{k_1} z_{k_2} \cdots z_{k_r}$ with coefficient $1$ in the free associative algebra $\mathbb{Q}\langle x, y \rangle$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ on two noncommuting letters $x$ and $y$, where $z_k = x^{k-1} y$. In other words, it is the Hoffman word of $\mathbf{k}$ viewed as an element of $\mathbb{Q}\langle x, y \rangle$. The empty…
nodes.title: Hoffman monomial of an index

nodes.summary: For a finite list $(k_1, \dots, k_r)$ of positive integers, this is the word $z_{k_1} z_{k_2} \cdots z_{k_r}$ in the free monoid on the two letters $x$ and $y$, where $z_k = x^{k-1} y$ is the Hoffman block of $k$. The empty list gives the empty word.
nodes.title: Hoffman word of a list of positive integers

nodes.summary: For an index $\mathbf{k} = (k_1, \dots, k_r)$ of positive integers, the Hoffman word of $\mathbf{k}$ is $z_{k_1} z_{k_2} \cdots z_{k_r}$ in the free monoid on the two letters $x$ and $y$, where $z_k = x^{k-1} y$. The empty index gives the empty word.
nodes.title: Hoffman word of an index

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
